decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that approval should be given for the external materials submitted:- i.e.
Roof - Kingspan KS1000RW profiled steel panel system with Colorcoat HPS 200 - standard colour: Olive Green SC (see drawing 210 107).
Facing Brickwork- Ibstock: Hardwick Minster Sandstone Mixture ref. 2418 - to be used on north and east elevations (see drawing 210 107).
Rendered Walls - One coat render system by Blue Circle: Colourtex S, Colour: Ivory (see drawing 210 107).
External Doors and Windows: White UPVC.
Paved Surfaces: 600x600x50mm precast concrete paving: Marshals Perfecta, colour: Natural
Car Parking Surfaces: Black tarmacadam,
as they would provide for durability and a satisfactory appearance in the long term, complementing the building and its setting in its location, in compliance with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow's adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003).
Condition : 2 - Informatives:
1		The applicant's attention is drawn to the fact that the planning decision is made on the basis of the roof material being Olive Green in colour as per the sample of material submitted.  The submitted drawing No.210 107 states that the roof colour will be slate grey. This informative is to confirm that a slate grey colour is equally acceptable and can be considered as a minor amendment to the approved details.
description:
